payload.rebuttal: fixed: The sibling-holder case spied on `runtime._call` but never checked the argv it recorded, so the probe network's exact name was unverified. Added an assertion that the spy's first call is `["network", "rm", f"saffron-regate-probe-{task_id}"]`. Verified by hand that swapping the name to `saffron-probe-regate-{task_id}` now fails this assertion.
